profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Anduril Industries
profile.summary: Versatile, self-motivated software developer with a passion for integrated/embedded systems and a strong technical background in numerous programming languages and operating systems.  Goal is to actively contribute to the development of novel technologies in a collaborative, fast paced environment while gaining a diverse breadth of experience.  Experienced in building a project from scratch and creating extensible solutions that other developers can continue to improve on with minimal time spent learning the system.
